package com.farmingpatchpopup.data;

/** The Time Tracking tabs a patch type is listed under (trimmed copy: only the names are used). */
public enum Tab
{
	OVERVIEW,
	CLOCK,
	BIRD_HOUSE,
	ALLOTMENT,
	FLOWER,
	HERB,
	TREE,
	FRUIT_TREE,
	HOPS,
	BUSH,
	GRAPE,
	SPECIAL,
	TIME_OFFSET
}
